items.title: 19.3.1 Models Proposed for the Mechanism of DNA Replication (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the models of replication (PDF 123).

blocks.text: DNA replication ke bunyadi tareeqe ke baare mein teen models pesh kiye gaye.

1- Conservative model: is model ke mutabiq parent (walid) DNA ka double helix saalim (intact) rehta hai. Yeh double helix aik naya double helix banata hai jo poora naye material ka hota hai. Is liye replication ke baad jab do daughter DNAs bante hain to:

items: aik daughter DNA mein parent DNA ke dono strands hote hain, aur
doosre daughter DNA mein dono strands naye hote hain.

blocks.text: 2- Semi-conservative model: is model ke mutabiq parent DNA ka double helix khul jata hai, yaani parent DNA ke dono strands alag ho jate hain. Har strand aik naye strand ke banne ke liye template (saancha) ka kaam karta hai. Is liye replication ke baad:

items: dono daughter DNAs mein aik strand parent DNA ka aur aik strand naya hota hai.

blocks.text: 3- Dispersive model: is model ke mutabiq parent double helix DNA toot kar nucleotides mein bikhar (disperse ho) jata hai. Phir yeh nucleotides naye nucleotides ke saath mil kar daughter DNAs ke chaar strands banate hain. Is liye replication ke baad:

items: dono daughter DNAs ke strands purane aur naye nucleotides ka mel (mixture) hote hain.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse, har aik mein aik replication. Har hisse mein parental DNA (dono strands surkh, purane) replication se do daughter DNAs banata hai. 1- Conservative model: aik beti poori nayi (neeli), aik poori purani. 2- Semi-conservative model: har beti mein aik purana aur aik naya strand. 3- Dispersive model: dono betiyon ka har strand purane aur naye tukron ka mel.

Teen models aik nazar mein
header: Aik replication ke baad daughter DNAs
rows: Parent double helix saalim rehta hai; naya double helix poora naye material ka.
Aik mein dono parent strands; doosre mein dono naye strands.
Parent ke dono strands alag hote hain; har strand naye strand ka template.
Har aik mein aik parent strand aur aik naya strand.
Parent DNA toot kar nucleotides mein bikhar jata hai; naye nucleotides se mil kar chaar strands.
Har strand purane aur naye nucleotides ka mel.

blocks.prompt: Semi-conservative model ke mutabiq do replications ke baad kitne DNA molecules mein asal (parent) strand baqi hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Chaar mein se do, yaani aadhe. In do mein aik aik purana strand hai; baqi do molecules ke dono strands naye hain.

items: Conservative: purana double helix poora mehfooz, doosra bilkul naya.
Semi-conservative: har daughter DNA = 1 purana + 1 naya strand.
Dispersive: har strand mein purane aur naye nucleotides mile hue.
